Upon the [[Galactic Constitution Conference|foundation]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="GaW" /> in [[25,053 BBY]],<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> a being served as its '''first Supreme Chancellor'''. The individual wore [[Robe/Legends|robes]] of [[Color/Legends|blue]] color. The same hue was eventually adopted for the [[Clothing/Legends|uniform]] of the [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]], an elite force tasked with protecting the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], and became a recurrent element of the Guard's attire over the [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]]-long existence of the Republic,<ref name="GaW" /> eventually coming to symbolize the Senate's supreme authority as well as the longevity of its rule.<ref name="VD">''[[Star Wars: The Phantom Menace: The Expanded Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:BirthOfARepublic-HistoryOfTheOldRepublic.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Illustration "Birth of the Republic" for the cancelled book ''History of the Old Republic'']]
The being referred to as "the first [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]]" was mentioned in the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[Galaxy at War]]'', which was published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GaW" />

For the cancelled ''[[Star Wars]]'' reference book ''[[History of the Old Republic]]'',<ref name="ArtStation">{{ArtStation|username=neechmonkey|url=artwork/4yOd8|name=Travis Wright|text=Star Forge Construction}}</ref> artist [[Travis Wright]] created an illustration depicting the foundation of the Galactic Republic. The illustration features a light-skinned, brown-[[Hair/Legends|haired]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] in blue attire standing in a podium<ref name="Blogspot">{{Blogspot|subdomain=neechart|url=2015/02/history-of-old-republic.html|name=The Art of TJ Wright|text=History of the Old Republic}}</ref> resembling the Supreme Chancellor's [[Chancellor's Podium/Legends|podium]] of the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building's]] [[Grand Convocation Chamber]]<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> and presenting a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] of a document's text to the other occupants of the chamber.<ref name="Blogspot" />
